temporal_review.rationale: Stable foundations are durable; frontier and tool claims should be reviewed within six months.

scope.summary: A field-entry path from point-set topology to algebraic topology, with a short applied frontier branch.
included: homology as the first algebraic invariant
persistent homology as an applied frontier example
interpretive_notes: The report treats topology as a formal field whose curriculum is organized by invariance, construction, and functoriality.

domain_profile.rationale: Core results are proof-driven and cumulative, while applied branches connect the same invariants to computational data workflows.
failure_modes: Treating visual deformation metaphors as definitions
Using invariants as if they were complete classifiers
Skipping quotient topology examples before algebraic topology

core_ideas.label: Invariance under continuous deformation
core_ideas.description: Topology replaces metric detail with properties preserved by continuous maps and equivalences.

core_ideas.label: Quotient construction
core_ideas.description: Quotients are the first serious test of whether a learner understands topology as a structure, not a picture.

methods.label: Homology
methods.description: Homology turns spaces and maps into algebraic data that can be computed, compared, and related functorially.

representations.label: Chain complex
representations.description: A chain complex represents geometric structure as graded groups with boundary maps whose cycles and boundaries form homology.

evidence_standards.summary: Foundational claims require a standard textbook or open course source; frontier claims require reviewed recent survey or article evidence.
evidence_standards.claim_policy: Cataloged source records are visible as bibliography candidates, but only reviewed or verified evidence links can support claims.

source_role_requirements.rationale: The curriculum depends on stable definitions and proof conventions.
Only the applied branch needs a current frontier source.
This topology path is not centered on large instruments or institutional data infrastructure.

waiver.rationale: No infrastructure-bound claim is made in this compact fixture.

sources.title: Topology

access.notes: Used as bibliographic support; no text is reproduced.

sources.why_it_matters: Standard reference for point-set topology and quotient examples.

sources.citation: Hatcher, Allen. Algebraic Topology. Cambridge University Press, 2002.
sources.title: Algebraic Topology
sources.why_it_matters: Provides the first algebraic topology spine: fundamental group, covering spaces, homology, and cohomology.

sources.title: A roadmap for the computation of persistent homology
sources.why_it_matters: Shows how homology becomes a computational pipeline for data analysis.

claims.statement: Topology is organized around invariants and maps that preserve structure under continuous deformation.

evidence_links.support_note: Point-set topology establishes the language of spaces, maps, and preserved properties.
Algebraic topology uses invariants to compare spaces and maps.

claims.statement: Quotient topology is a threshold concept because it exposes the difference between inherited intuition and formally defined open sets.

evidence_links.support_note: The book develops quotient topology through definitions and examples that drive later constructions.

claims.statement: Persistent homology is a useful applied frontier branch because it turns algebraic-topological invariants into computational summaries of data.

evidence_links.support_note: The roadmap describes computation, software, and data-analysis uses of persistent homology.

relations.description: Quotient constructions are interpreted by tracking which structure survives identification.

curriculum_path.title: Point-set grammar
curriculum_path.learning_goal: Use open sets, continuity, compactness, connectedness, and quotient maps without relying only on pictures.
curriculum_path.practice_artifact: Counterexample notebook for compactness, Hausdorffness, and quotient pathologies.
progress_criteria: Can distinguish metric and topological properties
Can construct and analyze quotient spaces

curriculum_path.title: Homotopy and homology
curriculum_path.learning_goal: Explain how loops, coverings, and chain complexes produce invariants.
curriculum_path.practice_artifact: Compute fundamental groups and cellular homology for standard spaces.
progress_criteria: Can compute a basic homology group from a cell structure

curriculum_path.title: Persistent homology branch
curriculum_path.learning_goal: Connect homology to filtrations, barcodes, and data-analysis use cases.
curriculum_path.practice_artifact: Annotated pipeline from filtered data to a barcode interpretation.
progress_criteria: Can describe what persistence adds beyond a single homology computation

frontier_debates.title: Persistent homology computation
frontier_debates.summary: Applied topology asks which invariants remain informative and computationally tractable for noisy data.
frontier_debates.why_it_matters: It tests whether algebraic-topological abstractions can support practical data analysis.

visual_views.title: Topology dependency path
visual_views.justification: A dependency view is justified because the curriculum has a strict order from point-set constructions to homology and then applied persistence.
